entries.dddca8a974e8dbbb: Under a 10-year management plan starting in 2022, the company has set out a 2031 vision of 'a company that continues to contribute to extending healthy life expectancy through the rapid creation and delivery of groundbreaking new drugs' and 'a drug discovery company that expands globally, centered on the dermatology and orthopedics fields'. As strategies to realize this vision, the company has formulated three Transformations: 'R&D', 'overseas expansion' and 'management foundation', and on April 8, 2025 it announced a partial revision of its Long-Term Management Plan 2031, including an increase in strategic investment amounts and stronger shareholder returns.
